import java.util.Scanner;
import java.util.ArrayList;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        ArrayList<Integer> arr = new ArrayList<>(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            arr.add(x);
        }
        int sum = 0;
        for (int x : arr) {
            sum += x;
        }
        System.out.print(sum / n);
    }
}
